title: American Airlines pilots perplexed after witnessing 'super bright' UFOs over Texas
description: Commercial pilots on an American Airlines flight reported a close encounter with unidentified bright objects during a routine flight over Texas, prompting new FAA interest.

title: Congress shown classified UAP videos that 'defy physics,' lawmaker says
description: Rep. Eric Burlison says classified UAP videos shown in a closed Pentagon briefing depict objects performing maneuvers that 'defy physics,' fueling declassification demands.

title: Hegseth doubles down on Trump's UAP disclosure promise as AARO's caseload exceeds 2,000
description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth reaffirmed the Trump administration's commitment to UAP transparency, noting AARO's caseload has officially surpassed 2,000 reports.

title: Hegseth shares update on government release of UFO files
description: Defense Secretary Hegseth says the Pentagon is actively working to identify and release UAP-related files in compliance with Trump's directive.

title: Congressman questions alleged massive overseas UAP structure
description: Rep. Eric Burlison reveals sources told him about a massive unidentified object in another country so large that a structure was built around it rather than moving it.

title: Washington promises UFO disclosure. History suggests otherwise.
description: A look at the long history of promised government transparency on UFOs — and how often those promises have fallen short of delivery.

title: Trump says he's directing the Pentagon to release files related to UFOs and aliens
description: President Trump announced on Truth Social that he will direct the DOD and other agencies to begin releasing government files on UAPs, UFOs, and extraterrestrial life.

title: Transparency proponents meet Trump's UAP disclosure tease with hope — and caution
description: UAP transparency advocates welcome Trump's declassification pledge, but insiders caution that impact will depend entirely on follow-through and enforcement.

title: Trump says government will declassify alien files
description: After Obama's comments that aliens are 'real,' Trump announces plans to declassify and release government files on extraterrestrial life and UAPs.

title: Trump's UFO order: What the government has already revealed about UFOs
description: A breakdown of what the government has already disclosed about UFOs and what Trump's new directive might add to the public record.

title: Trump orders Pentagon, federal agencies to release files on UFOs and aliens
description: International coverage of Trump's directive ordering the Pentagon and federal agencies to begin identifying and releasing UAP and alien-related government files.

title: Obama says aliens are 'real' before clarifying he's just guessing
description: Former President Obama tells a podcast host that aliens are 'real,' then clarifies he was speaking statistically about the likelihood of extraterrestrial life in the universe.

title: Trump orders UFO disclosure: What does it mean for us?
description: A psychological perspective on the societal impact of Trump's UFO disclosure directive — examining how confirmation of non-human intelligence could reshape public consciousness.

title: Trump's order to release evidence for aliens obscures the scientific search for extraterrestrial life
description: Scientists argue that Trump's disclosure push conflates military UAP investigations with the rigorous scientific search for extraterrestrial life, muddying both efforts.

title: 'We've been given marching orders': Congressman urges UFO disclosures, whistleblower protection
description: Rep. Burlison says the new Congress has 'marching orders' to push UFO transparency, including access to classified facilities and stronger whistleblower protections.

title: James Fox hosts landmark UAP press conference at the National Press Club
description: Filmmaker James Fox convened witnesses, medical experts, and government insiders at the National Press Club to present new evidence of alleged non-human encounters and crash-retrieval programs.

title: Warning issued that alien revelations could spark financial crisis
description: Former Bank of England analyst Helen McCaw warns the central bank to prepare contingency plans for the economic fallout if the US confirms the existence of non-human intelligence.

title: Hollywood is taking UFOs seriously with rival 'disclosure' projects
description: Spielberg's 'Disclosure Day,' a Bruckheimer-produced thriller with whistleblower David Grusch attached, and a Roswell film signal Hollywood's growing engagement with UAP.

title: I've reported on UFO sightings for decades — and come to this conclusion
description: Skeptic magazine publisher Michael Shermer shares his decades-long investigation of UFO claims and the broader cultural forces driving disclosure momentum.

title: In new doc 'The Age of Disclosure,' military servicemen expose more details about UFOs at Vandenberg
description: A new documentary features active and retired military personnel revealing firsthand accounts of UAP activity at Vandenberg Space Force Base on the California coast.

title: Congress wants to know more about the military's UAP intercepts around North America
description: The FY2026 NDAA directs AARO to brief Congress on the number, location, and nature of UAP intercepts by NORTHCOM and NORAD.

title: Pentagon UAP briefings added in NDAA
description: The FY2026 NDAA gives AARO three specific mandates for expanded Congressional briefings on UAP encounters dating back to 2004.

title: House Oversight hearing: Restoring public trust through UAP transparency and whistleblower protection
description: The House Oversight Committee held its third public hearing on UAPs, featuring testimony from whistleblowers and military witnesses on government transparency failures.

title: The Age of Disclosure: UFO doc reveals Russia discovered alien spacecraft
description: A new documentary featuring firsthand accounts explores claims that Russia recovered anomalous craft, adding to the growing global disclosure narrative.

title: UFO group reports more than 2,000 sightings in first half of 2025
description: A major UFO reporting organization documented over 2,000 sightings in just the first six months of 2025, marking a significant increase in public reporting.

title: AARO hosts private workshop with civilian researchers, universities, and government agencies
description: AARO convened civilian researchers and academic institutions alongside government agencies in a private workshop to discuss UAP analysis methodologies.

title: Trump fully briefed on UAPs, UFO whistleblower David Grusch says
description: Whistleblower David Grusch stated that President Trump has been fully briefed on unidentified anomalous phenomena, raising expectations for disclosure action.

title: UAP transparency under Trump 2.0: What the new administration could mean for UFO disclosure
description: Analysis of how the Trump administration's policy positions could accelerate or complicate the push for UAP transparency in government.
